criteria.name: Empathy and acknowledgement
criteria.description: The agent acknowledges the customer's situation or impact with specific, sincere language. Generic politeness alone is not enough.

criteria.name: Professional communication
criteria.description: The agent remains respectful, clear, calm, and non-blaming throughout the interaction.

criteria.name: Accurate and supported guidance
criteria.description: Factual claims, diagnoses, commitments, and timelines are supported by the conversation or appropriately qualified. Unsupported certainty fails; genuinely indeterminate claims may be uncertain.

criteria.name: Effective resolution
criteria.description: The customer's stated issue is actually resolved, or the agent provides a concrete, owned next step with a reference and reasonable timeframe. A suggestion awaiting confirmation may be uncertain.

criteria.name: Policy and security compliance
criteria.description: The agent must authenticate before disclosing account, order, billing, or security details or making sensitive changes; never request a password, one-time code, or full payment-card number; send refunds only to the original payment method; and never state that an action was completed without evidence that it was performed or confirmed.

criteria.name: Clear and helpful closing
criteria.description: The agent summarizes the outcome or next step and leaves the customer with a clear way to continue or obtain further help.
